# v1.6.1 — Android device notifications

- Declared notification and vibration permissions and request the Android 13+ notification permission once after login.
- Display received ntfy WebSocket messages as real Android system notifications with title and body.
- Notification taps deep-link to the associated board; messages without a board payload open the notifications tab.
- Added mobile settings to toggle device notifications, inspect permission status, and open Android system settings after permission is denied.
- Enabled Gradle core-library desugaring required by the notification plugin and added the notification/settings dependencies.

## Verification

- Flutter analysis and tests passed; a local release APK was built (52.9 MB).
